culture.text: Same merchant, same eight thousand people, same budget. An anime music festival and a family fair need different stock.

evidence.text: For each event, Qloo returns the films that audience loves in Taipei. Live calls.

onoff.text: Every plan is scored against the same simulated demand, so comparisons are fair.

audit.text: Each decision has an audit trail and a purchase order export.

plans.text: Three risk plans, and what-if scenarios such as afternoon rain.

ops.text: During the event, it recommends restocks from simulated sales.

agent.text: Now the agent. The vendor just types a request.

run.text: The same agent runs twice: once with Qloo tools, once without. This takes about a minute.

tools.text: With Qloo, it resolves tags, gets and ranks films, then asks Qloo who the crowd is, and what else they like.

citations.text: Every product decision cites Qloo: films, audience age, and taste tags. The server checks each citation.

without.text: Without Qloo, the same agent can only reason from the event name.

result.text: Across twenty runs, the Qloo agent won seventeen, by five hundred fifty two Taiwan dollars on average, on simulated demand.

close.text: TasteShift. Know your crowd. Choose your products. Stock with confidence.
